name: Detail Boiler Room (Web)
implementation_notes: Reuses BoilerRoomRecordService::getDetail() (BE service shared with screen-098, see that screen's implement artifact for the service/controller/route/factory/model files)

Field grouping/order in the Blade view mirrors mobile/src/views/DataPreviewBoilerRoomView.vue's detail mode exactly (Boiler Room ID, Tanggal, Inputted By, Checked By, Acknowledged By, Note, grid Boiler Room Detail with all 15 reading/status/text columns), per explicit product direction that web station screens mirror mobile flow/UX
Route /data/boiler-room/{id} registered after /data/boiler-room/create (screen-118) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
UNLIKE Detail Threshing: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no query, no reference data of any kind

404 handled automatically by ModelNotFoundException -> ApiExceptionHandler (findOrFail) for the API controller, and via the notFound flag in DetailBoilerRoom Livewire component, same as every other detail screen in this codebase

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/DetailBoilerRoomTest.php) exists following this codebase's established convention but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- verified only by static review, consistent with the codebase's Browser/* convention.
